symptom: `mxcli git merge` on ManualResolutionRequired printed no property-level report at all when either side's mx diff failed (exit 129 on a constant whose ExportLevel was "" on one side and Hidden on the other), so a reader could not tell 'no details' from 'the diff crashed'
cause: The call site only called propertyReport when both diffs returned nil, with no else; propertyReport already rendered a missing file as '(diff unavailable: …)', but never saw the run's error
fix: propertyReport takes each side's diff error (diffSide) and is always called: a failed side prints '(diff unavailable: <error on one line>)', the other side its changes
insight: A guard that skips output on any error turns one side's failure into silence about both; let the renderer own each side's failure. The mx diff crash itself reproduces on 11.14.0 ("" vs Hidden ExportLevel: exit 129), see ako/mxcli#1980
